CloudAthlete.title: CloudAthlete
CloudAthlete.description: Cloud-synced athlete profile and personal best record owned by an authenticated coach.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning coach.

name.description: Full name of the athlete (1..120 chars).

category.description: Event category such as Track or Field (1..40 chars).

specificEvent.description: Primary event name such as 100m Sprint (1..60 chars).

pbValue.description: Personal best value formatted string (1..40 chars).

pbUnit.description: Measurement unit such as Saat (s) or Meter (m) (1..40 chars).

clubName.description: Club or school team name (1..120 chars).

coachEmail.description: Email address of the coach (1..120 chars).

dateOfBirth.description: Optional date of birth string (<= 30 chars).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the athlete document was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the athlete document was last updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CloudRaceRecord.title: CloudRaceRecord
CloudRaceRecord.description: Cloud-synced electronic timing race result and AI posture biomechanics telemetry.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning coach.

title.description: Race title such as Race 1 (1..120 chars).

eventName.description: Event name such as 100m Sprint (1..80 chars).

athleteName.description: Athlete name recorded for the race (1..120 chars).

windReading.description: Wind gauge reading such as +0.8 m/s (1..40 chars).

coachEmail.description: Email address of the coach (1..120 chars).

cadenceSpM.description: Optional cadence in steps per minute.

groundContactTimeMs.description: Optional ground contact time in milliseconds.

torsoLeanAngleDeg.description: Optional torso lean angle in degrees at finish gate.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the race record was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the race record was last updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/athletes/{athleteId}.description: Collection of athlete profiles and personal best records scoped by userId.

/race_records/{raceId}.description: Collection of electronic timing race results and biomechanical telemetry scoped by userId.
